Name: Leek Peek -- Forage Preview
Author: cmeents
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
I’ve done many play-throughs of Stardew Valley, and every time I got to the “Gifts for George” quest, I got frustrated. I was tired of spending hours of in-game time going from the Backwoods to the far side of the Mountain only to discover there was not a leek to be found. I never found a mod that told me whether I should spend time looking, so here we are. My first (and probably last) mod.

Leek Peek gives you a quick summary of what's available for gathering as soon as you arrive in an area. Check for forage, artifact spots, and berry bushes at a glance, then get on with playing instead of combing the map. The feeling of looking for them when you know they're there is completely different from running around hoping they're there.  Leek Peek tells you what's out there—but never where to find it. It’s for those of us who want to cheat just a little bit but not too much.


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Reports forage available in the current area. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional reporting of artifact spots. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional reporting of ripe berry bushes. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional reporting of items on the farm. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional mod title on HUD. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional "Nothing found" message. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional notification sound when items are present. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Configurable display duration. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Configurable HUD position. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Full Generic Mod Config Menu support (or config.json if you prefer). [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]·  Does [b]not[/b] reveal item locations.
·  Does [b]not[/b] highlight forage.
·  Does [b]not[/b] change spawn rates.[/color]


[b][size=4]Compatibility and limitations[/size][/b]
Leek Peek can report modded forage when the item is tagged as forage_item. Some expansion mods spawn forage without that tag, so those items may not appear in the report.

Leek Peek reports items present in the entire area. This can include items in inaccessible or locked portions of the map, so an item listed in the report may not always be reachable.

[b]Ginger Island:[/b] Golden walnuts found on bushes are reported as Berry Bushes. Buried golden walnuts and walnuts obtained in other ways are not reported.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI [/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+ [/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, but recommended) [/*]
[/list]I made this mod for myself, but if you can use it, I hope you use those leek-seeking hours in a useful way. Maybe buying beers for Shane or finding an interesting place for Lewis’s golden statue.
